claim.disposition: The single-phase under-coverage (4/14) is attributed to three individually verified route-geometry limitations (T1-link blindness; satellite-blind T-B joins; T-C midpoint overshoot); their joint sufficiency was validated by the Gate 3 execution run — the R2 route (cycle-walk + set-class predicate) derives O cleanly at all four licensed contexts. The derivation was then re-executed on derived inputs (the un-granting program's recovered κ, cycle-ground, and R-edges replacing the granted architecture) and produced the identical comparison block — field-for-field, digest-for-digest — proving the pipeline's semantics are independent of the inputs' provenance.
claim.significance: The input-isolation assertion is the amendment's distinguishing evidence: the derivation ran on derived inputs with zero granted bytes in the derivation path (grantedBytesInDerivationPath: 0, mechanically enforced by the two-sided static isolation check; 59 mutation probes rejected; one licensed observation read, asserted) — the first amendment in project history with this property. The D4 record's original not_derived outcome was derived under granted inputs; this corridor's re-derivation ran under derived inputs and produced the identical comparison block — proving the record's resolution is independent of the inputs' provenance, and completing the un-granting program's arc from granted architecture to derived architecture.
claim.falsifiability: The corridor's success branch was pre-registered (the BL-079 design specification's three-branch falsifiability structure; the deepest branch: provenance-dependence). The Gate 3 run determined the branch by measurement, never toward an expected outcome. The pre-registered baseline was the frozen receipt's comparison block itself; any deviation would have been a finding (the branch table existing and tested; a spurious-deviation probe rejected by the validator). No deviation occurred; the branch classified DERIVED_FROM_DERIVED_INPUTS. The provenance-independence of the record's resolution is thereby demonstrated at the registered bounds (derived inputs plus the named anchoring remainder).
claim.d7Clause: Hypothesis-tier context, carried honestly: the paired D7 test returned an asymmetric finding (literal-P 0/14, input-level class asymmetry; class-P 14/14 = U = O full-domain restatement, C2 guard; cycle-twin 0/7 as refined by BL-070: the modal orbit's rotations exist at interval 6 but don't transport to the D4 verification set {1, 2} — an interval-transport failure, not a rotational absence); the ti-pole's derivation behavior differs structurally from the fa-pole's; no D7 claim, no D7 amendment, D7 hypothesis-tier preserved; the asymmetry feeds the governs semantic layer as data.
